# TeamShastra

> TeamShastra is field service management software for owners, managers, and technicians in India.

TeamShastra helps field service teams run jobs, attendance, customers, quotations, GST invoices, purchases, expenses, cash float, bank balances, and reports from one company workspace. Android app on Google Play; web app at app.teamshastra.com.

## Product features

- Jobs and work orders: assign technicians, today's board, comments, before/after photos, completion report PDFs
- Attendance and leave: check-in/out with optional punch-time location; works offline; no all-day GPS tracking
- GST invoices and quotations: catalog, tax invoices, payments, pending collections, WhatsApp PDFs
- CA-ready GST exports (not GST portal filing)
- Purchase bills and supplier balances
- Field expenses, cash float given to staff, and bank balances
- Customers, AMC contracts, due visits, optional customer portal
- Reports: job summary, technician performance, revenue
- Languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali
- Built for CCTV installers, electricians, maintenance teams, and similar B2B field businesses
